units.source_text: 独脚大仙指了指这条狗，说道：“它的名字叫阿嗅，不管是发生在什么地方的事情，他都能嗅的出来。

en.t: The one-legged immortal pointed at the dog and said, “Its name is Axiu. No matter where something has happened, he can sniff it out.

units.source_text: 那么，从此之后就要拜托你好好照顾它了。”

en.t: So from now on, I will entrust him to you. Please take good care of him.”

units.source_text: 话音未落，独脚大仙就化作一缕青烟，消失的无影无踪了。

en.t: Before the words had even faded, the one-legged immortal turned into a wisp of blue smoke and vanished without a trace.
